description: Scan a public security, trust, compliance, or legal page for common enterprise buying signals before you claim a vendor supports a particular compliance posture. It looks for public references to SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, DPA terms, subprocessors, SSO, SCIM, encryption, and data residency language. This is a signal scanner, not proof of certification or legal sufficiency.

url.description: Public trust, security, compliance, or policy URL to scan.

name: assess_compliance_posture

cached.description: True when the page body came from the 5-minute cache.

error.description: Fetch or parsing error when the page could not be analyzed.

matchedSignals.description: Signal names that were detected on the page.

pageLength.description: Size of the fetched page body in characters.

signals.description: Boolean scan results for common enterprise compliance and security signals.

dataResidency.description: True when the page references data residency, data regions, or regional storage controls.

dpa.description: True when the page references a data processing agreement or DPA.

encryption.description: True when the page references encryption, data encrypted at rest, or data encrypted in transit.

gdpr.description: True when the page references GDPR or the General Data Protection Regulation.

hipaa.description: True when the page references HIPAA compliance language.

iso27001.description: True when the page references ISO 27001 certification or compliance language.

scim.description: True when the page references SCIM provisioning.

soc2.description: True when the page references SOC 2 or SOC2 compliance language.

sso.description: True when the page references SSO or single sign-on.

subprocessorList.description: True when the page references subprocessors or a subprocessor list.

url.description: Compliance or trust page that was analyzed.

title: Compliance Signal Scan
